figures.caption: Figure 3. Spatial Enrichment Profile of CD4+ T Cell Subpopulations Relative to Tregs. Dot plot representing the spatial co-localization analysis between each CD4+ T cell cluster (X-axis) and Regulatory T cells (Tregs). The Y-axis depicts the log2-transformed ratio of observed to expected pairwise cell interactions (log2(Observed / Expected)). The horizontal dashed line (Y = 0) marks spatial randomness. Circle colours indicate the enrichment conclusion based on adjusted p-values: red for statistically significant overenrichment (spatial attraction), blue for significant underenrichment (spatial avoidance), and grey for no significant spatial deviation. Circle sizes denote the significance threshold: small (non-significant, p >= 0.05), medium (p < 0.05), and large (p < 0.01).
